<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.13.2 -->

## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix: backport 1.13.1 fixes and image security updates to 1.12.9 by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16119
* fix: absorb lxml and Mako image workarounds for 1.12.9 by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16123
* fix: authenticate starter project MCP clients in auto-login mode by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16151
* fix: preserve document identities during knowledge base ingestion by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16134
* fix: preserve loop items and distinct outputs in list inputs by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16147
* fix: honor detected Windows-1254 text encoding by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16149
* fix: enforce flow permissions for event access by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16150
* fix: run knowledge base rollback off the event loop by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16148
* fix: preserve numeric column types in Parser templates by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16146
* fix: honor MCP flow visibility for project resources by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16127
* fix: validate class pattern attributes by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16126
* fix: enforce outbound request policy for OpenAPI agents by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16125
* fix: validate MCP shell wrapper arguments consistently by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16124
* fix: authenticate project MCP clients in auto-login mode by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16186
* fix: allow first ingestion into a new OpenSearch index by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16171
* fix: patch release 1.12.10 image vulnerabilities by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16201
* fix: patch bundled npm glob and minimatch for 1.12.10 by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16205
* fix(lfx): apply Split Text Text Key to lists of Data records by @olayinkaadelakun in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16164
* fix: harden release 1.13.2 image dependencies by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16196
* fix(lfx): report input length and format in Batch Run metadata by @olayinkaadelakun in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16152
* fix: preserve integer IDs in Parser Stringify tables by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16214
* fix(schema): stop sending "None" as the default of table columns without one by @viktoravelino in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16144
* fix: validate forwarded prefixes as URL paths by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16242
* fix: scope frozen vertex results to the build caller by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16239
* fix(frontend): create one flow on a repeated New Flow click by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16232
* fix(agents): keep parallel tool results on their own run by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16233
* fix(api): recover milestones a slow event stream dropped by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16234
* fix(components): send If-Else message on default route by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16275
* fix: make model provider sections collapsible (LE-3358) by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16281
* fix(security): reject frozen and ZIP loader imports by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16282
* fix(deps): dependency upgrades for 1.13.2 by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16169
* fix(models): clear rejected Bedrock sampling fields before retrying by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16298
* fix: revoke refresh sessions on logout by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16293
* fix(tracing): isolate concurrent Phoenix workflows by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16294
* fix(serialization): sanitize nonfinite NumPy and pandas floats by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16297
* fix(deps): use patched Zod in the docs toolchain by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16299
* fix(security): require admin custom-code authoring by default by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16288
* fix(lfx): keep non-string text values in Message by @MohammadHijjawi97 in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16218
* fix(api): rename a flow that loses a concurrent create for its name by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16302
* fix(graph): give list inputs the same value order in every process by @viktoravelino in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16285
* fix: stop Filter Values crashing on ordinary text filters by @viktoravelino in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16202
* fix(lfx): keep top-level JSON arrays in JSON Cleaner by @MohammadHijjawi97 in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16206
* fix: reset model provider scroll on selection by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16314
* fix(amazon): address Bedrock Converse QA failures by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16326
### 📝 Documentation Updates
* docs: clarify 1.13.2 upgrades and project authentication by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16318
### ✅ Tests
* test(security): cover reflective namespace laundering by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16243
* test(auth): cover trusted proxy credential sources by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16238
### Others
* ci: centralize Chromium runner defaults on Ubuntu 24.04 by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16155
* fix: apply connector URL policy before connecting to NextPlaid by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16283
* fix: require owner credentials for every webhook run by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16284
* fix(authz): refuse unavailable configured plugins by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16286
* fix(serve): scope durable workflow operations to caller by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16287
* fix(security): reject unsafe library execution sinks by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16289
* fix: enforce credential destinations during provider validation by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16290
* fix: keep public API Request destinations fixed by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16291
* fix: recheck execution identity and tool approval at runtime by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16292


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/compare/v1.13.1...v1.13.2
